original_raw_decisions.code_evidence: The candidate performs tune-only global threshold calibration, evaluates tune micro-F1 after each epoch, checkpoints the best target-aligned epoch, and records the threshold and validation trajectory in meta.json.
Training selection is based on tune micro-F1 after threshold search rather than BCE or unweighted validation loss; the selected epoch and optimizer settings are persisted.
The implementation uses a self-contained residual image model with lazy PIL decoding, no pretrained assets, dense two-dimensional labels, and deterministic saved state plus preprocessing metadata.
The model uses tune-only threshold calibration over 0.02 through 0.50, argmax fallback for empty rows, and saves exact reload metadata.
The compact CNN contract is retained as a stronger SmallResNet variant with BCEWithLogitsLoss, lazy decoding, deterministic reload, global threshold calibration, and argmax fallback.
The candidate trains with BCEWithLogitsLoss, evaluates convergence on the labeled tune split, calibrates one global threshold, and never uses hidden or unlabeled data for fitting.
